what: a line of text (22 letters, 7.81 mm high) on a block's top face, running over the block's edge, cut 1 mm deep with a -5 deg taper: 145 s in truck (the untapered cut takes 1 s)
method: a 1 mm cut of glyphs into a 40 mm block leaves one valid closed body; the glyph areas are not closed-form, so only the outcome is graded, within the run's timeout (truck took 145 s; over the edge with a join it never finished)
